summary: Iteration-4 verification of NexusHesap Phase-4 (module ordering, Firma Ayarları, print/form system, Teklif/Proje/Keşif, Stoklar & Ürünler). BACKEND: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (26 cases) + iteration-3 regression suite re-run => 52/53 passed (98%). Covered: PUT /api/auth/me/preferences (persist + disallowed-key filtering), GET/PUT /api/companies/{id} (+404), print-templates GET defaults for 4 doc types / PUT persist / invalid doc_type 400, /einvoice/providers (5) and GET/PUT /einvoice/settings (configured/simulated transitions, password never returned, bad provider 400), POST /api/files/upload (png->quote.images, company logo -> company.logo_url and file served 200 image/png, pdf allowed, txt 400), quotes (TKF numbering, 2000/400/2400 totals, empty items 400, status update, items recalculation on PUT, convert-to-invoice with matching totals + contact balance +grand_total + double-convert 400, delete, 404), projects (PRJ numbering, missing name 400, status PUT, list quote_count/quoted_total/invoiced_total aggregation, delete, 404), surveys (KSF numbering, status PUT, convert-to-quote item Duvar 12x150 = 1800/2160 with survey status quoted + quote_id, delete, 404). FRONTEND (public preview URL): /settings all 8 tabs render clean (no console errors) — company info edit+save toast, logo input present, print template editor (footer edit + save + persistence), e-invoice provider configure -> YAPILANDIRILDI and reset -> SİMÜLE, module up/down reorders the sidebar instantly and survives reload, sidebar HTML5 drag&drop DID work (nav-item-contacts dropped on nav-item-dashboard reordered). /projects: quote create with searchable cari + product picker ('kulak' -> price 1899 auto-filled), row with totals, print preview with correct number/subtotal/KDV/grand total + Yazdır, send -> Gönderildi, image upload -> thumbnail, convert -> NX invoice number in row, reject -> Reddedildi, delete; projects create/status/'Teklif Oluştur' prefilled; surveys create with measurement, 'Yapıldı', 'Teklife Çevir' -> quote appears in Teklifler tab. /contacts?contact_id=cnt_01: detail print buttons for invoices and orders open PrintDocument with 'Form Düzenle' -> template editor; detail-goto-invoices-btn -> /invoices?contact_id=cnt_01 (filter works) and detail-goto-orders-btn -> /orders?customer=...; print-inv-btn / print-order-btn previews OK. /stock: heading 'Stoklar & Ürünler', both tabs + go-stock-count-btn show stock-count-panel, product edit form KDV Detayları (Alış KDV, KDV dahil, istisna kodu) and tags editor (Enter -> chip, saved chip visible in product row). Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt $2b$12$ hash, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None+Partitioned access/refresh cookies, allow_credentials=True with explicit CORS_ORIGINS env list. All test artefacts cleaned via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iteration4.py; cnt_01 balance restored to -73.573,73; user's mail account (bilgi@matekdekor.com) untouched.

minor.issue: Response omits user.preferences (only login returns it). AuthContext line 58 reads res.data.user?.preferences?.module_order on session check, so the server-side module_order is NEVER applied: verified by writing module_order with '/settings' first, clearing localStorage and reloading -> sidebar fell back to the default order. Module ordering is effectively localStorage-only (lost on cache clear / other browser / other device). Fix: add "preferences": user.get("preferences", {}) to get_me().

Document numbers are generated from count_documents({}), so numbers are reused after a delete (observed TKF-2026-0003 issued twice after the first one was deleted) and are not company-scoped. Use a counters collection or max(existing number)+1 per company.

contact_id is hardcoded to 'cnt_01' while contact_name comes from the marketplace order, so 5 'Ayşe Gökmen (Pazaryeri Müşterisi)' invoices are attached to Trend Mağazacılık (cnt_01). This corrupts the contact statement/balance and makes /invoices?contact_id=cnt_01 show foreign customers. Create/lookup a real contact per marketplace customer.
Resetting provider to '' keeps the stored password_enc (has_password stays true, UI still shows 'Şifre (kayıtlı)'). Consider clearing credentials when the integrator is unset.
Still returns Mongo `_id` next to `id` in every payload (carried over from iteration 3).

ui_bugs.issue: PrintDocument is rendered without onEditTemplate, so the 'Form Düzenle' button is missing on quote previews (it exists on invoice and order previews). Spec asks for Yazdır + Form Düzenle on invoices, orders AND quotes.

Modal stays open after a successful save (row updates behind it) and its overlay blocks all clicks on the table, so the user must close it manually; automated re-open of another product was blocked by the overlay.
React DOM-nesting error persists: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (thrown while rendering select options).

integration_issues.issue: Order only survives because of localStorage; server preferences are written but never read back (GET /api/auth/me has no preferences field), so ordering is not per-user cross-device.

issues: 'Geçerlilik', 'Keşif Tarihi', 'Başlangıç/Bitiş' use the raw browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy, US format inside a Turkish UI) instead of a styled/locale-aware date picker
'Red' (reject) action is a plain text button with no icon/confirm; rejecting is irreversible from the UI (no way to move a rejected quote back to draft)

action_items: Add `"preferences": user.get("preferences", {})` to GET /api/auth/me so module_order is restored from the server (currently localStorage-only).
Pass onEditTemplate to PrintDocument in ProjectsPage so quotes also get the 'Form Düzenle' button.
Replace count_documents-based numbering (_next_number) with a per-company counter to avoid reused TKF/PRJ/KSF numbers after deletion.
Stop hardcoding contact_id='cnt_01' in ecommerce sync / order->invoice creation (server.py:2033 & 2197); resolve or create the real contact.
Close the product edit modal after a successful save (or at least stop the overlay from blocking the grid).
Optional: clear stored e-invoice password when provider is reset to '' ; fix the <span> inside <option> DOM-nesting warning.
critical_code_review_comments: get_me() and login return different user shapes (login includes preferences, /auth/me does not) — the frontend relies on the richer shape; keep one serializer for the user object.
server.py is now 2500 lines with settings/quotes/projects/surveys appended at the top of the file before /auth/register; split into routers per the 700-line guideline.
update_company / update_project / update_survey silently ignore unknown keys and return 200 even when nothing matched (update_company does not 404 on unknown company id).

convert_quote_to_invoice builds the invoice dict inline and re-implements numbering (NX+count) instead of reusing create_invoice — duplicate logic drifts from the invoices endpoint (e.g. no stock/e-type validation).
_calc_items mutates the caller's item dicts in place; acceptable here but surprising for a helper named 'calc'.

success_rate.backend: 98% (52/53 pytest cases; only the /auth/me preferences assertion fails)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all Phase-4 flows work; missing 'Form Düzenle' on quote preview + module order not server-restored)

rca_of_the_issue: Module ordering persistence: update_preferences writes preferences.module_order to db.users (verified in Mongo), but get_me() serialises only id/email/name/role/active_company_id. AuthContext.checkAuth reads res.data.user?.preferences?.module_order, gets undefined, and keeps the localStorage/default order. Reproduce: PUT /api/auth/me/preferences {module_order:['/settings',...]} -> 200; GET /api/auth/me -> user object without 'preferences'; clear localStorage['module_order'] and reload -> sidebar shows default order. Fix: return preferences from get_me (one line), same shape as the login response.
